name: Dill Weed
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as herbs are typically used in small quantities and don't significantly contribute FODMAPs.
preparationTips: Add fresh dill at the end of cooking to preserve flavor and color
Chop finely to release maximum flavor from the delicate leaves
Store fresh dill in refrigerator wrapped in damp paper towel
Can be frozen in ice cube trays with water or oil for convenience
